sections.name: body
sections.value:
PR #147 plan 213 review: block at 29488cad374621621303fe1153c695784cb914ce, request 325693b633ea1aca-000000000000009d through reviewer/147.

F001 P2: the CJS fast selector's value-flag inventory lacks --body, --from and --msg-id. Values are read as recipients, so valid native role sends with those options first miss forwarding and reach the old unsupported parser. A --msg-id value that looks like role: also misclassifies a seat send. Fix native send arity handling and test ordering/opaque values, not just the presence of six flags.

F002 P2: a paneless child with an inherited PIJ_SESSION_ID fast-forwards instead of taking observed ambient registration. Old routing explicitly overwrites inherited IDs with the daemon-observed native host. Native acting-seat resolution without a pane uses the asserted ID, so the parent can become the sender. Keep all paneless sends routed, or perform equivalent verified admission before forwarding. The selector branch is reproduced; wrong-sender consequence is source-traced, not a live impersonation run.

N001 P3: a supported leading --json invocation still loads tsx; the advertised fast-path latency applies to verb-first calls. Locate the verb for classification without changing forwarded argv.

Exact-head CI run 42191982701: all four jobs green, 1,976 passed/five skipped. JUnit confirms two clap and five shim contract tests. Their chosen positive cases do not cover the failing boundaries.

Niced/background local check: full-shim recording positive passed; first kept-path case timed out at ten seconds, not attributed to the product. No recorder-specific routed child survived. A pure oracle executed the unchanged production selector with positive/negative controls and reproduced F001/F002 without a daemon/Rust build or dependency changes.

Report: ../outputs/2026-11/pr-147-verdict.md
Oracle: ../outputs/2026-11/pr-147-selector-oracle.cjs

Magic wand: a fast path must preserve the identity bootstrap it bypasses. Test the branch decision against native flag arity and inherited session claims, not just byte parity after it is selected.
